subject: Request: Trial extension + credits + discount for ClearSkin POC
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@clearskin.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-08T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot request + trial extension and promotional credits

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency and the prefix-caching demo. We are excited to run a 90-day pilot across two product lines (customer support and product recommendations).

A couple of asks from procurement and my exec sponsor:
- Can Redwood extend the free trial from 30 to 90 days?
- Can we get $30k in platform credits to cover initial usage for the pilot?
- Separately, can we get a one-time 20% discount on the first 12 months if we convert after pilot?

This pilot has clear upside: design win into a 4-year contract if the pilot proves out (estimated ARR ~ $420k). Sponsor is CC'd (procurement contact below). We can sign a simple mutual action plan / PO if terms are agreed.

Attaching the pilot brief and procurement questionnaire for context. Let me know if I should jump on a call to walk through requirements.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Data Science, ClearSkin Inc.
emma@clearskin.com

Attachments: ClearSkin_MAV_Request.pdf
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma@clearskin.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-08T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request + trial extension and promotional credits

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the materials. Great to hear the demo landed well.

Quick answers: I can escalate the combined request (90-day extension + $30k credits + 20% convert discount) to leadership. To speed this, could you confirm:
- Pilot start date target (we need to align capacity)
- Expected peak concurrent requests and an approximate token/day figure
- Whether ClearSkin requires SOC2/IL compliance evidence in the next 30 days (we can deliver select docs but need lead time)

If you want, I can propose a conditional package (exec-approved) that pairs credits with a shorten-to-convert commitment to protect our economics. Looping Rishi to review.

I’ll follow up with an internal approval request this morning and keep you posted.

— Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-09T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request + trial extension and promotional credits — approval request

Rishi / Ava — need a quick decision on a combined credits+discount exception for ClearSkin (details below). They want: 90-day trial extension, $30k in platform credits, and a one-time 20% discount on year-1 if they convert.

Why I’m asking:
- Opportunity: potential ARR ~ $420k with a 4-year expected deal if pilot succeeds
- Risk: upfront credits + 20% discount together exceed typical promo stack — needs exec sign-off
- Constraints: ClearSkin requests quick turnaround; procurement wants a conditional PO within 30 days if approved

Attached: Deal_Overview.xlsx and our draft MAV_Proposal_v1 (pricing outline). Recommended ask from me: approve up to $25k credits + 15% discount with a requirement for an executed PO/commitment within 45 days, otherwise credits reclaimable. If you prefer, I can propose a staged credit release tied to milestones.

Can you weigh in? Quick call ok if easier.

— Priyom
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-10T10:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request + trial extension and promotional credits — approval request

Thanks Priyom. I appreciate the ask and the context. High level thoughts:
- The ARR upside is material; I’m comfortable with promotional credits to enable a proof point.
- However, stacking $30k credits with a full 20% discount is heavy on margin. I’d prefer a compromise that protects our conversion economics.

Proposed exec exception (for Finance sign-off):
- Trial extension to 90 days — approved
- Platform credits: $20,000 — approved conditionally (50% released at start, 50% on meeting milestone 2: 30M tokens processed or agreed functional checkpoint)
- Discount: 15% on year-1 if they sign within 60 days of pilot end

Ask Markus to sign off on the discount exception (pricing) and for Finance to validate the credit accounting. If Markus approves, I’ll have the legal/CS teams prepare a conditional MAV and credit-reclaim clause.

— Rishi
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-11T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request + trial extension and promotional credits — approval request

Thanks — I agree with Rishi’s approach with one tweak to tighten exposure. Approved terms (final):
- Trial extension: 90 days (approved)
- Platform credits: $25,000 total (25% on start / 75% on milestone 2: operational & business-readout)
- Discount: 10% on year-1 if they execute within 30 days of pilot completion

Conditions:
1) ClearSkin must sign a simple MAV/LOI outlining milestones and conversion windows within 14 days of acceptance.
2) Credits are subject to clawback if they exceed normal pilot usage patterns (to be defined in the MAV).
3) Finance to confirm accounting treatment — Ava, please confirm credit provisioning and impact to forecast.

Priyom — once Finance signs off, please send the conditional terms to Emma and CC procurement. Keep legal on the thread for the MAV.

— Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma@clearskin.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-12T18:22:00-08:00
Subject: Approved: Pilot terms and next steps (ClearSkin)

Emma — good news: leadership has approved a conditional promotional package to enable your 90-day pilot. Summary of approved terms (subject to Finance/legal MAV):
- Trial extension: 90 days (pilot start date to be confirmed)
- Platform credits: $25,000 total (25% released at pilot start; remaining 75% released upon completion of milestone 2 — operational readiness and business readout)
- Discount: 10% off year-1 list if ClearSkin signs within 30 days after pilot completion

Conditions:
1) We’ll need a signed MAV/LOI that outlines milestones, PO/commitment timelines, and credit clawback terms within 14 days of accepting these terms.
2) Finance will validate credit provisioning (Ava is on copy).
3) Technical kickoff and capacity planning call to lock the pilot start date this week.

If you’re comfortable with this, I’ll have legal send a one-page conditional MAV and we’ll schedule the kickoff. Thanks for moving quickly on the details — excited to partner.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAV_Proposal_v1.pdf, Deal_Overview.xlsx
